method: Visual inspection of saved browser screenshots, alongside the completed product interaction validation.
observations: New K115 standard and quick galleries display their separate supplied photographs, with upright, pendent and horizontal sidewall thumbnails.
Desktop gallery headings, imagery and thumbnail controls are readable without horizontal clipping.
Arabic mobile galleries retain right-to-left layout and the three configuration thumbnails without horizontal overflow.
English standard and Arabic quick mobile model tables show three distinct orientation/model rows and K115 / 68°C values.
The EC gallery displays its restored EC-ZST sample images rather than the ordinary K115 quick-response image derivatives.
